capabilities: Searches full text across all configured vaults
Previews notes from other vaults read-only
Links notes across vaults with [[Vault::Note]] syntax
Moves or copies notes between vaults
Finds duplicate and similar notes across vaults
extras: Manual installation only. The plugin reads files outside the active vault and keeps a search index cache in the active vault's plugin folder; caching note text can be turned off if that config folder is synced or published.
intentEvidence: Natively, Obsidian does not allow you to open a note from outside the active vault in a tab.
motivation: To let people who keep separate work, personal and writing vaults search, view and switch between them as if they were one workspace.
problem: Obsidian works with one vault at a time, so notes in other vaults cannot be searched, previewed or linked from the current one.
summary: Plugin that indexes and searches notes across multiple Obsidian vaults, with read-only previews, cross-vault links and duplicate detection.
